thread:
maria: Heads up — I just saw a panel preview render rows from a different org after I switched workspaces quickly :scream:
alex: ugh, repro steps?
maria: repro: 1) open org A dashboard 2) click a panel to prefetch 3) switch to org B quickly 4) open the same dashboard -> panel shows org A rows. Happens ~1/5 tries locally.
jordan: can you paste the exact request/headers from the network tab?
maria: sure — the prefetch call looks like:
```
GET /api/console/prefetch?panel_id=3487 HTTP/1.1
Host: console.redwood.dev
Authorization: Bearer xxx
X-Org-ID: 742
User-Agent: Console/1.23.0
```
alex: interesting — cache logs?
maria: grabbed logs from local canary: 
```
INFO prefetch_key=console:prefetch:user:alice:path=/dash/900 hits=1 org=742
INFO cache_set key=console:prefetch:user:alice:path=/dash/900 ttl=60
INFO prefetch_request key_lookup=console:prefetch:user:alice:path=/dash/900 org_header=742
```
maria: note: the cache key above doesn't include org id — that's likely the bug.
jordan: oh — so when you fast-switch, a subsequent request with a different X-Org-ID hits the same cache key and returns the old body.
sam: telemetry: I just queried telemetry for prefetch hits by key pattern and saw ~12 cross-org hits in last hour in prod-us-west. Pattern: console:prefetch:user:*:path=* (no org).
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 1735012000 -> 1735012120 completed for console-prefetch-service :rocket:
alex: immediate mitigation: 1) short circuit cache on missing org in key (fast) 2) include X-Org-ID in cache key (safer) 3) add request-level guard to compare X-Org-ID in cached payload before returning.
jordan: agree. Also add an integration test that races two requests with different org headers to assert isolation.
maria: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4214 — adds org to cache key + guard + unit test.
alex: nice. Will roll to canary once CI passes. Watch quota/requests to origin — adding org to key will increase cache cardinality and might spike backend token/DB reads briefly.
sam: good call — I'll add a dashboard tile to monitor prefetch-origin-reads and tenant-miss-rate, alert if increase > 2x baseline.
jordan: also add telemetry tag `org_id` to the cached-miss span so we can filter.
maria: CI green on PR, merging in 2m.
deply-bot: (typo) oops ignore
deploy-bot: Rolling canary for PR #4214 -> canary-1735012305
alex: monitoring: if we see sudden quota/throughput spike, auto rollback plan is to toggle PREFETCH_CACHE_ENABLED=false for canary group.
sam: added alert: prefetch.origin_reads > 100/min for canary group -> pager.
jordan: follow-up: long-term we should move to tenant-scoped cache shards or include org in cache namespace at the gateway level to avoid any service forgetting to key by org.
maria: agreed. Filing follow-up issue #4320 (tenant-scoped cache migration)
alex: thx everyone — nice quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
sam: deploy metrics look clean so far, no cross-tenant errors in logs after canary roll.
maria: thanks y'all. I still want a postmortem note in weekly eng sync about this kind of prefetch hazard — adding to agenda.
alex: add short blurb to runbook: "always include tenant id in cache keys for user-visible data"
jordan: will do.
maria: closing thread once the runbook & issue exist. :)
